distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 11.8163 +/- 0.0623 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91): 84.63 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 10.339 (10.126 to 10.552) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 7,192,557 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 2.700 (2.592 to 2.809) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5026 +/- 6.5 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 818464227945910016: teff_gspphot 5025.682 K (16th-84th percentiles 5018.935-5031.9653), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 818464227945910016: teff_gspphot 5025.682 K (16th-84th percentiles 5018.935-5031.9653), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
